clips.title: The story
paras: Brill Town Hall anchors Forsaken rule in the shattered heart of Lordaeron. From its doors, the undead govern Brill and coordinate the defense of Tirisfal Glades.

Brill Town Hall remains open under Forsaken rule while much of Lordaeron lies in ruins. Magistrate Sevren directs town affairs from his podium, issuing orders to Forsaken travelers. Beyond the Defiler's Den in the Arathi Highlands, few recognized town halls in the known world remain active under Forsaken control. Brill’s hall carries on Lordaeron’s old civic order beneath undead rule.
